description.p: Search the whole internet, then listen, save, download and manage everything in one place.
The desktop app runs a private Soundsible station on this computer, or connects to one you already run on a server.

ul.li: Search the YouTube Music catalogue or paste a link; listen, save without downloading, or download
Browse your music by artist, album, genre or year, with playlists and favourites
Endless playback, radio, autoplay and an automatic DJ that mixes between songs
Synced lyrics, podcasts, and imports from Spotify and Apple Music exports
Media keys and desktop media controls through MPRIS
